text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I have lost. A complete defeat...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, could you wait
just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No no no!
What kind of running was that?! Have you no shame,
Lucky Lilac?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Not my training results,
nor the strategy you put so much thought into...
I couldn't make use of a single thing...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Why'd that happen?
Was my opponent too strong?
No, it's just 'cause I was weak!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
A star? Don't make me laugh!
You can't even pull yourself together to look the part, so stop daydreaming so much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Obsession with winning, clutch factor, grit—
you're completely lacking in all of 'em.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Train like your life depends on it
and try again, you dumbass!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to have kept you waiting.
I apologize for putting on such an unsightly display today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without blaming anyone else, Lucky Lilac squarely
accepted her defeat.
It is a truly admirable attitude. And yet—
choice_data_list: At least when you lose, it's okay to let yourself feel completely frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for your concern.
However, I am quite alright.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well, I ran wild to my heart's content back there...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No, nothing at all.
Well, losing can't be helped.
What matters is the next one, the next one!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let us re-examine our running anew,
and prepare for a comeback.
choice_data_list: As long as you're that prepared, you'll be fine next time.
As long as you're that prepared, you'll be fine next time.
Then it's time for a strategy meeting. We'll get our revenge!
Then let's have a strategy meeting. We're going to get our revenge!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let us re-examine our running anew,
and prepare for a comeback.
choice_data_list: As long as you're that prepared, you'll be fine next time.
As long as you're that prepared, you'll be fine next time.
Then it's time for a strategy meeting. We'll get our revenge!
Then let's have a strategy meeting. We're going to get our revenge!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aye, at the very least, I gotta carry myself
like a true star.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Let's clearly show 'em in the next race
that our running is the real star of the show, too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're such a dependable Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's brainstorm.
A way to get our super-sized revenge.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Taking things lying down simply goes against my nature.
